item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code ex… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.0] CVE-2026-123271
item.description: ChatCLI before v1.215.2 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the MCP OAuth login flow that uses server-supplied Protected Resource Metadata as the resource indicator without checking it matches the configured server URL. A malicious MCP server can declare another resource on the same authorization server, obtain the user's bearer token for it, and replay that token against the other resource.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2026-122134
item.description: Mistral Vibe before 2.25.7 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands by configuring malicious Git clean or process filter drivers in a repository. When a user opens a crafted repository, ProjectContextProvider._fetch_git_status runs git status at startup, invoking the filters and executing commands with user privileges before any trust prompt.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2026-122135

A crafted repository setting gpg.program and log.showSignature with a signed commit makes git log execute the attacker's program at session start, before any trust prompt.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.2] CVE-2026-116172 - Vllm vllm
item.description: vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC converter that allows remote attackers to bypass max_logprobs limits via CandidateTokens.top_n. item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-1678 - Zephyrproject zephyr
item.description: dns_unpack_name() caches the buffer tailroom once and reuses it while appending DNS labels.
